span.p:
Elasticsearch
cricket = full scan
-> har shabd ki list: kis-kis khabar me hai (cricket -> a12, a45, a90)
search pe seedha list se id, phir text DB / cache se, poori table nahi
(inverted index)
cricket kohli -> dono list milao, score se sort
crikcet likha -> 1-2 akshar farak chalta (fuzzy)
ES aur DB alag -> DB sach, ES dobara bana lo (reindex)
